title: Morning Kayak & Seal Cruise in Vancouver
blurb: Explore a nearby Island by kayak just minutes from Vancouver! No experience necessary. Our guided tour will take you by boat to a nearby island, and let you explore the incredible Howe Sound. Find yourself surrounded by white-capped mountains, marine wildlife, and spectacular views only found in the Pacific Northwest. We often encounter wildlife like seals, bald eagles, and much more. No experience necessary! Don't forget to bring a bathing suit and towel if you want to partake in cannon balls off the boat!
